title: fix(app-shell): packaged flow rows keep their height; the platform reason opens from a neutral chip (objectui#12609)
body:
Fixes #12609

Clause-②: yes

Setup › Packaged automation: a flow row that carries the runtime's `reason` sentence no longer grows to several lines. The sentence opens, verbatim and in full, from a neutral **Details** chip on the flow name's line. This is the card as triage narrowed it (comment 6210990723): target 3 only, the half that classifies nothing.

## What changed

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx`
  - The paragraph element that rendered `row.reason` inside the flow cell is gone.
  - A new local component, `ReasonDetails`, draws a small outline chip (an Info icon and the word "Details") inline after the flow's label. The chip opens a popover that shows the sentence whole and muted, with no alert role.
  - The chip renders only when the row carries a non-empty string `reason`. That rule is the existing one in `joinPackagedFlows`, unchanged. The chip's label, icon and classes are the same on every row, and nothing reads, matches or compares the sentence.
  - A popover, not a tooltip: the sentence runs to several lines and can name an operator switch the admin needs to copy. A popover opens on click, tap and keyboard, and stays open to be read and selected.
  - Rows without a reason render the same markup as before.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: one new key, `packagedAutomation.reasonDetails`, in all ten packs. Each pack uses the word it already uses for "Details" elsewhere.
- `.changeset/12609-packaged-flow-reason-chip.md`: a patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, with the Clause-② paragraph (one pack key added; no export or prop changes).

## Governing text

`@objectstack/spec` `FlowRuntimeState.reason`, verbatim: "A free-form sentence, deliberately — the shape the two surfaces that already carry this reason use. Consumers RENDER it; ⛔ do not parse it." This PR adds no regex, `includes` or match on the reason, and the chip's wording names no cause.

## Tests

`PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx`, section 6 (the platform reason for an unbound flow), reworked:

- **A deployment-policy row and a binding-failure row.** The row holds no paragraph element and none of the sentence. Its "Details" chip opens a dialog-role disclosure whose text is exactly the sentence: muted, with no alert.
- **The chip does not classify.** The policy row's chip and the binding-failure row's chip have the same text ("Details") and the same classes.
- **Rows without a reason have no chip and the same text as before.** This covers a bound row, a disabled row, an older backend's bare row and a non-string reason.

`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx`: 15 passed (15).

### Ablation (each red proven, then restored)

Each mutation went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. The anchor must hit, and the tool checks on-disk counts and blob hashes. Restore is proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The test imports the page from `src/`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

| Mutation | Red tests |
|---|---|
| A: the reason paragraph put back in the row, chip kept | policy row, binding-failure row: 2 failed, 13 passed (the row's paragraph count was 1, not 0) |
| B: the chip removed | policy row, binding-failure row, does-not-classify: 3 failed, 12 passed |
| C: the chip drawn on every row | no-reason rows, non-string reason: 2 failed, 13 passed |
| D: the chip's label chosen from the sentence's words | policy row, does-not-classify: 2 failed, 13 passed |

Mutation A's first attempt was refused by the tool before anything ran. Its replacement contained the anchor, so the anchor count could not drop. It was re-anchored and re-run, and the counts above come from the run whose mutation landed.

## Local gates, all on `ad380ce`

objectui is hand-derived from its own `package.json` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Each exit code was captured before any pipe. CI runs the full farm.

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` (upstream closure of app-shell, which contains i18n's): exit 0, 28 tasks successful (28)
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. app-shell's `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so the test file is compiled.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/ packages/i18n/`: exit 0, 88 files passed, 1387 tests passed, 13 skipped
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (1 key added, 0 values changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (the new key is not listed): exit 0
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm changeset:check`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0
- `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `pnpm check:spec-symbols`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new): exit 0
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the 12 changed `.ts` and `.tsx` files: exit 0, no output

## Acceptance notes

- **The switch is unchanged.** It still shows the row's `enabled` field, so a flow that deployment policy keeps unarmed still reads On. Showing the effective state needs the structured discriminator that objectstack-ai/objectstack#23842 adds, and this PR does not touch the switch.
- **Card targets 1 and 2 are not here.** The chip that names the deployment policy and the once-banner both need that discriminator. Per triage, the console half of those is filed once the field is in a published `@objectstack/spec`.
- **Acceptance 2, the screenshot at 1280 px in light and dark: NOT MEASURED in this run.** A reader needs four things:
  - a backend with packaged time-triggered flows and `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED` unset, so those rows carry the policy sentence;
  - a console started from this branch, on its own port, pointed at that backend;
  - the page `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/component/automation/packaged`;
  - a click on a row's Details chip, to read the popover.
- **Row height in pixels: NOT MEASURED.** No browser ran here. What the tests pin is structural: the row holds no paragraph, and the chip sits inline in the label's line (`leading-4` text, a one-pixel border, no vertical padding). Rows without a reason were already two lines tall (the label above the machine name), in cells with the table primitive's `p-4` padding. So the claim this PR makes is "a reason row is as tall as any other row", not a pixel figure; the screenshot reading above should take the figure.
- **Card acceptance 3, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`:** the whole-package run is left to CI. Locally, the setup directory and the whole i18n package ran, as listed above.
- **Docs:** no page under `content/docs/` describes how this page shows the reason, so no doc changed.
- **Overlap:** objectui#12606 (another seat, in flight) owns the header row of Setup component pages. This PR touches only this file's flow rows and its module docblock, and the later lander merges `main`.
